column1: # Fixture files vendored for the factorized entries' tests: path (relative to crates/vakint), sha256 of the file, origin.
# Checked by tests/fixture_manifest_tests.rs: every listed file has its sha256, and the three fixture directories hold
#   wh-fixtures:<path>        the R* producer's fixture export (the directory VAKINT_TEST_WH_FIXTURES names), byte for byte
#   l3-hard-dump:<path>       the producer's three-loop caller dump with hard parts (VAKINT_TEST_L3_HARD_DUMP), byte for byte
#   review-probe:<path>       the inputs of an external review's port probe (VAKINT_TEST_REVIEW_PROBE), byte for byte
#   recorded:<how>            written by a test on a named commit
#   derived:<how> / written:<how>   made for these tests; the label line of the file says what it is
#   base:<note>               present before these fixtures were vendored
#   hole-cut-cases:<path>     the producer's published one-hedge (v1.5) cases (VAKINT_TEST_HOLE_CUT_CASES), byte for byte
#   record-roots:<path>       a production record of the producer's first record root (the first directory of VAKINT_TEST_RECORD_ROOTS), byte for byte
